# README Title Feature - Visual Examples

This document demonstrates the visual output of the README.md generation with molecule titles feature.

## Example 1: Simple Molecule with Readme Atoms

**Scenario:** A molecule called "Arm" contains two readme atoms

**Generated README.md:**
```markdown
###### Note: Do not edit this file directly, it is automatically generated from the CAD model

# MyProject

![](/project.svg)

### Arm

Text in the first readme atom

Text in the second readme atom
```

## Example 2: Nested Molecules

**Scenario:** A top-level project with a "Robot" molecule containing an "Arm" molecule and a "Gripper" molecule

**Generated README.md:**
```markdown
###### Note: Do not edit this file directly, it is automatically generated from the CAD model

# RobotProject

![](/project.svg)

Project overview text from top-level readme atoms

### Robot

This is the main robot assembly

### Arm

The arm is 50cm long

Made from aluminum

### Gripper

The gripper can hold 5kg

Uses servo motors
```

## Example 3: Multiple Top-Level Readme Atoms

**Scenario:** Top-level project with readme atoms but no molecules

**Generated README.md:**
```markdown
###### Note: Do not edit this file directly, it is automatically generated from the CAD model

# SimpleProject

![](/project.svg)

This is a simple project description

Additional project notes

Usage instructions
```

Note: Top-level molecules don't add their own heading since the project name is already H1.

## Before vs After Comparison

### Before This Feature:
```markdown
# MyProject

Text about component A
Details about component A
Text about component B
More details about component B
```
❌ No clear separation between different components

### After This Feature:
```markdown
# MyProject

### Component A

Text about component A
Details about component A

### Component B

Text about component B
More details about component B
```
✅ Clear hierarchical structure with component headings
